en.title: Co-prime Count (Euler's Totient)
en.description:
Given an array A of positive integers, return an array B of the same length, where B[i] is the number of integers in [1,A[i]] that are coprime with A[i].

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n positive integers. Site constraints: 1≤n≤5000, 1≤A[i]≤100000; the upper bound on n and the larger output allowance are there to fit this site's standard-output judging.
en.output: Output the coprime count of each A[i] in input order.
en.explanation: Sieve-style update: start with φ[x]=x; for each prime p, subtract φ[x]/p from φ[x] for each of its multiples, then read φ[A[i]] in input order.
